Ahri.watch: If Ahri E Charm hits you, you can take her entire follow-up combo. Stand behind minions to avoid it. Ahri Q Orb of Deception can also hit on the way back, so move out of its return path even after dodging the first pass.
Ahri.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle to survive and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first against Ahri's main damage, but remember that magic resistance does not reduce the true damage from the return of Ahri Q Orb of Deception.
Ahri.fight: Right after dodging Ahri E Charm, place a soldier with Azir W Arise! and deal damage. While Ahri R Spirit Rush is down, you can look to close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands.
Ahri.laning: Move with the minion wave between you and Ahri to avoid Ahri E Charm. Place an Azir W Arise! soldier between the enemy minions and Ahri to last-hit and poke, but summon it only when needed to conserve mana and soldier charges.
Ahri.combo: To poke, place a soldier with Azir W Arise!, attack through it, then send it toward Ahri with Azir Q Conquering Sands while keeping the attack command active. If Ahri E Charm and Ahri R Spirit Rush are down and your allies can follow, place a soldier behind Ahri, dash across with Azir E Shifting Sands, and push her toward your allies with Azir R Emperor's Divide.
Ahri.escape: Right after dodging Ahri E Charm is your chance to engage.
Ahri.phase: Azir is weakest early, so focus on farming safely and do not stand forward in lane when you do not know where the enemy jungler is. In mid game, Azir Q Conquering Sands can be used more frequently, letting you manage soldiers more often. In late game, Azir grows stronger as he gains attack speed and ability power.
Ahri.teamfight: Keep Azir back and use soldiers placed with Azir W Arise! to attack the frontline continuously. If Ahri dives your backline, push her away with Azir R Emperor's Divide. Right after Ahri E Charm is used, focus her with your allies.

Akshan.watch: Akshan Q Avengerang gains range each time it hits an enemy, so do not rely on standing behind minions to absorb it; dodge both its outgoing and return paths. Akshan R Comeuppance deals more damage based on missing health, so move behind terrain if he targets you while you are low. Akshan W Going Rogue lets him approach, so check vision around the river and jungle walls.
Akshan.build: Akshan's main damage is physical, and Azir has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Early on, buy Cloth Armor to survive and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Akshan.fight: Right after forcing Akshan to use Akshan E Heroic Swing is your chance to close the gap. Until then, attack through soldiers placed with Azir W Arise!, and use Azir Q Conquering Sands when you need to move a soldier back into attack range. When engaging, close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands and push Akshan away with Azir R Emperor's Divide.
Akshan.laning: Early on, aim to farm safely by placing soldiers between the enemy minions and Akshan. Akshan Q Avengerang can gain range by hitting minions, so do not rely on standing behind the wave. If you do not know where the enemy jungler is, do not stand forward in lane, and save one soldier for escape.
Akshan.combo: To poke, place a soldier with Azir W Arise!, attack through it, then reposition it toward Akshan with Azir Q Conquering Sands. If Akshan E Heroic Swing is down and your allies can follow, place a soldier behind Akshan, dash across with Azir E Shifting Sands, then use Azir R Emperor's Divide toward your allies. Azir E Shifting Sands stops if you collide with Akshan along the way, so check the soldier's position and your approach angle first.
Akshan.escape: Consider closing the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands only right after Akshan E Heroic Swing is used. To escape, place the soldier you saved beyond a wall with Azir W Arise! and dash to it with Azir E Shifting Sands. If Akshan dives in, push him away with Azir R Emperor's Divide to create distance.
Akshan.phase: Azir is weakest early, so farm against Akshan while minimizing losses. In mid game, Azir Q Conquering Sands has a shorter cooldown, and you can manage soldiers more often. In late game, once you have attack speed and ability power, deal sustained damage with soldiers from the back.
Akshan.teamfight: Keep Azir himself back and use soldiers placed with Azir W Arise! to attack the frontline. When an ally has a Scoundrel mark, avoid facing Akshan alone and fight outside his finishing range so he cannot finish off that ally and trigger a revive. If Akshan dives your backline, push him away with Azir R Emperor's Divide.

Akali.watch: The lower your health, the more dangerous the second hit of Akali R Perfect Execution becomes.
Akali.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Akali's main damage is magic, and Azir has low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance. Build Banshee's Veil to prepare for Akali R Perfect Execution's targeted dash, and add penetration to deal with Akali's high magic resistance.
Akali.fight: Keep your distance from Akali based on the position of soldiers placed with Azir W Arise! while dealing damage. When Akali briefly becomes visible as she enters Akali W Twilight Shroud, you can send a soldier with Azir Q Conquering Sands to hit her. Even after Akali W Twilight Shroud and Akali E Shuriken Flip are used, check whether she has other mobility available before engaging.
Akali.laning: Place soldiers between the minions and Akali to last-hit while pressuring her approach. Fight back when Akali comes out of the shroud to attack, but prioritize safe farming early because Azir is also weak then. If you do not know where the enemy jungler is, do not stand forward, and save one soldier for escape.
Akali.combo: To poke, place a soldier in front of Akali with Azir W Arise!, attack through it, then send it toward her with Azir Q Conquering Sands while keeping the attack command active. If Akali has used her mobility and your allies can follow, place a soldier behind her, dash across with Azir E Shifting Sands, then use Azir R Emperor's Divide toward your allies. Position the soldier so Azir E Shifting Sands does not stop when you collide with Akali.
Akali.escape: Even after Akali W Twilight Shroud and Akali E Shuriken Flip are used, check whether Akali R Perfect Execution is still available. The window when Akali R Perfect Execution is also unavailable is your chance to engage: close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands and use Azir R Emperor's Divide.
Akali.phase: In mid game, the cooldown of Azir Q Conquering Sands decreases, making soldiers easier to manage. In late game, Azir grows stronger with attack speed and ability power, so deal sustained damage from a safe position.
Akali.teamfight: Keep Azir himself back and send only soldiers placed with Azir W Arise! forward to attack the frontline. If Akali dives your backline, push her away with Azir R Emperor's Divide, and save one soldier so you can escape with Azir E Shifting Sands. Use Azir E Shifting Sands and Azir R Emperor's Divide to push Akali toward your allies only in a fight you are certain to win.

Ambessa.watch: When you see the shield and windup of Ambessa W Repudiation, stop attacking and walk out of its range. If you completely dodge the first hit of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Ambessa Q Sundering Slam, the second hit does not come out. If dodging is difficult, avoid the edge of the hitbox by moving close to her. If Ambessa E Lacerate hits you, use Azir E Shifting Sands to dodge the next hit instead of waiting for the slow to end. Ambessa R Public Execution cannot be stopped and targets the farthest champion in a straight line, so do not line up with your backline during a standoff.
Ambessa.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor to survive and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Ambessa's damage is mostly physical, so build armor first.
Ambessa.fight: Trade right after Ambessa has used her abilities and charges of Ambessa P Drakehound's Step. Keep your distance and attack with soldiers placed by Azir W Arise!, and do not attack during the windup of Ambessa W Repudiation. When Ambessa's mobility and crowd control are down and an opening appears, close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands and push her away with Azir R Emperor's Divide.
Ambessa.laning: Place Azir W Arise! soldiers between the enemy minions and Ambessa to last-hit and poke. Aim to farm safely early, and do not stand forward in lane when you do not know where the enemy jungler is. Azir Q Conquering Sands has a long early cooldown, so use it when you have a reason to move a soldier, and save one soldier so you can escape with Azir E Shifting Sands.
Ambessa.combo: To poke, place a soldier in front of Ambessa with Azir W Arise!, attack through it, then send it toward her with Azir Q Conquering Sands. Keep the attack command active while using Azir Q Conquering Sands so the soldier attacks again as soon as it arrives.
Ambessa.escape: Right after Ambessa has used her abilities and charges of Ambessa P Drakehound's Step is your chance to go in. In particular, once the slow from Ambessa E Lacerate is used, you can engage with Azir E Shifting Sands toward the soldier you saved. First check whether you can leave a soldier and a way to get back.
Ambessa.phase: Azir is weak early, so avoid giving up kills and safely gain levels and CS. Ambessa is strong in mid game as she completes core items, so do not face her alone. Azir can start taking fights once the cooldown of Azir Q Conquering Sands decreases and he can manage soldiers faster. In late game, Azir grows stronger with attack speed and ability power, so deal sustained damage with soldiers from the back.
Ambessa.teamfight: Keep Azir himself back and continuously attack the frontline with soldiers from Azir W Arise!. If Ambessa dives your backline, push her away with Azir R Emperor's Divide. Position yourself so your backline is not at the far end of the line of Ambessa R Public Execution. Try to engage and push an enemy toward your allies only when your team is clearly winning the fight.

Anivia.watch: Anivia Q Flash Frost can detonate mid-flight and stun you, so stay outside its range. If it hits, use Azir E Shifting Sands to escape Anivia E Frostbite follow-up. Leave Anivia R Glacial Storm immediately; staying in it increases Frostbite damage. In narrow paths, watch where you fight, as Anivia W Crystallize can block your retreat.
Anivia.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle to survive the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Anivia's main damage is magic, and Azir has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Anivia.fight: Keep your distance based on the position of the soldier summoned with Azir W Arise! and attack continuously. If Anivia Q Flash Frost hits you, stop trading and use Azir E Shifting Sands to avoid the Frostbite follow-up.
Anivia.laning: Place a soldier from Azir W Arise! between the minions and Anivia to secure last hits while pressuring her approach. Prioritize safe farming early, and stay back if you do not know where the enemy jungler is.
Anivia.combo: To poke, summon a soldier with Azir W Arise!, attack through it, then reposition it toward Anivia with Azir Q Conquering Sands. When your team can follow up on a kill, place a soldier behind Anivia, cross over with Azir E Shifting Sands, then immediately use Azir R Emperor's Divide toward your team. Azir E Shifting Sands stops if it collides with Anivia, so check your path when placing the soldier.
Anivia.escape: After the stun from Anivia Q Flash Frost is used, you have an opening to close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands. Anivia has no mobility ability, so if you reach her, push her back with Azir R Emperor's Divide. Engage only when your team is close enough to follow up.
Anivia.phase: Azir is weak early, so farm safely and minimize losses. Soldier control becomes easier in the mid game, and Azir grows stronger late as he gains attack speed and ability power. Avoid risky solo fights until then.
Anivia.teamfight: Stay back and keep attacking the frontline with soldiers. Fight in open areas when possible, as Anivia W Crystallize can block retreats through narrow paths. If an enemy reaches your backline, push them away with Azir R Emperor's Divide. Push an enemy toward your team only when your team is certain to win the fight.

AurelionSol.watch: Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on maximum health and generates Stardust, so stand behind minions without remaining in its line of fire. At low health, watch for the execute from Aurelion Sol E Singularity; if caught in it, move out immediately. Late in the game, spread out so multiple teammates are not hit by empowered Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
AurelionSol.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle to survive the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Aurelion Sol's main damage is magic, and Azir has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
AurelionSol.fight: Right after Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is used is your chance to close the gap. Choose your soldier's position before approaching with Azir E Shifting Sands, and go deep only when your team is close enough to follow up. Do not fight while taking prolonged damage from Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light; move out of its line of fire.
AurelionSol.laning: Place a soldier between the enemy minions and Aurelion Sol to create both last-hit and poke opportunities. Save mana by summoning soldiers when you need a last hit or Aurelion Sol enters range. Pressure him early to prevent him from stacking Stardust, but stay back if you do not know where the enemy jungler is.
AurelionSol.combo: To poke, summon a soldier with Azir W Arise!, attack through it, then send it toward Aurelion Sol with Azir Q Conquering Sands while maintaining the attack command. If Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight has been used and your team can follow up, place a soldier behind him, cross over with Azir E Shifting Sands, then use Azir R Emperor's Divide toward your team. Angle the soldier so Azir E Shifting Sands does not stop on Aurelion Sol.
AurelionSol.escape: Engage right after Aurelion Sol uses Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight. Close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands and push him back with Azir R Emperor's Divide to make escaping difficult. Before engaging, also check your route for avoiding Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
AurelionSol.phase: Both champions are weak early, but Aurelion Sol is weakest before he stacks Stardust. Farm safely as Azir and pressure him when Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is used. Azir's soldier control improves in the mid game and his sustained damage grows strong late, but Aurelion Sol also stacks Stardust permanently, making him harder to face the longer he is allowed to scale.
AurelionSol.teamfight: Stay back and keep attacking the frontline with soldiers. If Aurelion Sol engages with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight, push him away with Azir R Emperor's Divide to protect your backline. Spread out from your team to avoid being hit together by empowered Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, and do not cluster in narrow paths.

Annie.watch: When white light swirls around Annie, the stun from Annie P Pyromania is ready, so stay outside her ability range. In teamfights, avoid standing on top of teammates to prevent a group stun from Annie R Summon: Tibbers. Once Tibbers is summoned, leave the area even if you kill Annie.
Annie.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle to survive the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Annie deals magic damage, and Azir has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Annie.fight: When the stun from Annie P Pyromania is used, attack from a distance through a soldier summoned with Azir W Arise! Annie has no mobility ability, so you can engage with Azir E Shifting Sands when an opening to close the gap appears. Consider Azir R Emperor's Divide first as a way to push Annie away when she engages, rather than as an engage tool.
Annie.laning: Place a soldier from Azir W Arise! between the minions and Annie to seek last hits and poke. Summon a soldier when Annie enters range or you need a last hit, and keep one charge available so you can escape with Azir E Shifting Sands. If Annie's stun is ready or you do not know where the enemy jungler is, stay back and farm safely.
Annie.combo: To poke, summon a soldier with Azir W Arise!, attack through it, then send it toward Annie with Azir Q Conquering Sands while maintaining the attack command. If the stun from Annie P Pyromania has been used and your team can follow up, place a soldier behind Annie, cross over with Azir E Shifting Sands, then use Azir R Emperor's Divide toward your team. Position the soldier so Azir E Shifting Sands does not stop on Annie.
Annie.escape: Right after Annie uses the stun from Annie P Pyromania is your chance to engage. Annie has no mobility ability, so you can close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands and push her back with Azir R Emperor's Divide. If her stun is ready, do not engage; keep a soldier available to secure an escape route with Azir E Shifting Sands.
Annie.phase: Azir is weak early, and Azir Q Conquering Sands has a long cooldown, so focus on farming safely. In the mid game, Azir Q Conquering Sands and soldier control become faster; pressure Annie when her stun is used. Late in the game, Azir grows strong with attack speed and ability power, so deal sustained damage with soldiers from the back.
Annie.teamfight: If Annie is missing or the stun from Annie P Pyromania is ready, do not stand on top of teammates. Stay back as Azir and attack the frontline with soldiers from Azir W Arise! If Annie reaches your backline, push her away with Azir R Emperor's Divide. Keep your distance from Tibbers after Annie R Summon: Tibbers is used.

Aurora.watch: If Aurora Q Twofold Hex hits you, move out of the line between you and Aurora to avoid its returning damage. The returning damage increases as your health falls, so retreat before the curse returns when your health is low enough to be at risk. If you expect Aurora R Between Worlds, leave before the area forms; if you are already trapped, account for the slow when leaving it.
Aurora.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Aurora's main damage is magic, and Azir has low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance.
Aurora.fight: Use the position of a soldier summoned with Azir W Arise! to find an attack angle. Attack once through the soldier, then move it with Azir Q Conquering Sands to seek another hit. Even if Aurora W Across the Veil has been used, do not force an engage if Aurora E The Weirding or Aurora R Between Worlds is still available. If Aurora's mobility abilities have been used, especially before Aurora R Between Worlds comes back up, you can close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands.
Aurora.laning: Place a soldier from Azir W Arise! between the enemy minions and Aurora to secure last hits while discouraging her approach. Summon a soldier when she enters range or you need a last hit, and save mana when neither applies. Prioritize safe farming while Azir is weak early, and stay back if you do not know where the enemy jungler is.
Aurora.combo: To poke, summon a soldier in front of Aurora with Azir W Arise!, attack through it, then send it toward her with Azir Q Conquering Sands. Maintain the attack command as the soldier moves to seek another hit as soon as it arrives. When Aurora's mobility abilities have been used and you engage, place a soldier behind her, cross over with Azir E Shifting Sands, then use Azir R Emperor's Divide toward your team.
Aurora.escape: Look to engage when Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora E The Weirding have been used and Aurora R Between Worlds has not come back up. If only one mobility ability has been used, wait; she can escape with the other. Close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands, but attempt an engage using Azir R Emperor's Divide only when your team is close enough to follow up.
Aurora.phase: Azir is weakest early, so farm against Aurora while minimizing losses. In the mid game, the cooldown of Azir Q Conquering Sands decreases and soldier control becomes faster, giving Azir a workable way to fight. Late in the game, Azir grows strong with attack speed and ability power, so deal sustained damage with soldiers from the back.
Aurora.teamfight: Stay back and attack the frontline with soldiers. If Aurora reaches your backline, push her away with Azir R Emperor's Divide. If she leaps in and no one is killed, use that moment to try to catch her. Participating in a takedown resets the cooldown of Aurora's leap ability, so do not leave a low-health teammate behind when retreating.

Cassiopeia.watch: If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast hits, move out of range until the poison wears off to avoid the empowered damage and healing from Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. You cannot use Azir E Shifting Sands inside Cassiopeia W Miasma, so walk out. When you see Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze begin casting, turn away to avoid the stun.
Cassiopeia.build: Cassiopeia deals mainly magic damage, and Azir has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Cassiopeia.fight: Use Azir W Arise! to place soldiers, keep your distance, and deal damage in short trades. If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast hits, stop trading and fight again after the poison wears off. After Cassiopeia has used W Miasma and R Petrifying Gaze, look for a chance to close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands.
Cassiopeia.laning: Azir is weak early, so prioritize safe farming. Place a soldier with Azir W Arise! between the enemy minions and Cassiopeia to secure last hits while pressuring her approach. Place soldiers only when needed, and do not stand forward in lane if the enemy jungler's location is unknown.
Cassiopeia.combo: To poke, place a soldier with Azir W Arise!, attack through it, then move it toward Cassiopeia with Azir Q Conquering Sands for one more hit. If Cassiopeia W Miasma and R Petrifying Gaze are down and your allies can follow up, place a soldier behind her, cross over with Azir E Shifting Sands, and use Azir R Emperor's Divide toward your allies. Position the soldier so Cassiopeia's body does not block Azir E Shifting Sands.
Cassiopeia.escape: Cassiopeia has no mobility ability, so the moment after she uses W Miasma and R Petrifying Gaze is a chance to engage. Close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands along a path that avoids Cassiopeia W Miasma, then push her away with Azir R Emperor's Divide. Save one Azir W Arise! soldier charge in case you need to escape.
Cassiopeia.phase: Azir is weak early, so farm while minimizing losses. In mid game, you can use Azir Q Conquering Sands more often and cycle soldiers faster, making fights easier to set up. Late game, Azir also deals strong sustained damage, but Cassiopeia is strong in teamfights if she is not caught, so avoid engaging head-on.
Cassiopeia.teamfight: Stay back and keep attacking the frontline with soldiers from Azir W Arise!. If Cassiopeia enters your team's backline, push her away with Azir R Emperor's Divide. When moving in to catch her, wait until just after she uses Cassiopeia W Miasma elsewhere, then cut off her path with Azir R Emperor's Divide.

Corki.watch: Corki R Missile Barrage also hits around the first target, so do not hide behind minions; move out of range. Reposition to avoid being hit by successive missiles, especially the third. Corki E Gatling Gun reduces armor and magic resistance when it hits, so move sideways instead of standing your ground in front of him.
Corki.build: Early on, survive with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Corki's main damage is physical, and Azir has low armor, so prioritize armor. Corki P Hextech Munitions' true damage cannot be blocked with resistances; when you're in range of Corki E Gatling Gun, get out first instead of stacking more resistance.
Corki.fight: Set up your attacks around the position of a soldier placed with Azir W Arise!, putting it in front of Corki and attacking with it first. Follow with Azir Q Conquering Sands when you have a reason to move the soldier toward Corki, and do not waste it given its long early cooldown. Just after Corki W Valkyrie is used is a chance to close the gap.
Corki.laning: Place a soldier between the minions and Corki to secure last hits while pressuring his approach. Place a soldier only when Corki enters range or you need a last hit, and save one Azir W Arise! charge to escape. Azir is weak early, so farm safely without letting Corki farm freely.
Corki.combo: To poke, place a soldier in front of Corki with Azir W Arise! and attack with it, then send it toward him with Azir Q Conquering Sands. Keep the attack command active during Q so the soldier attacks again as soon as it arrives. If Corki W Valkyrie is down and your allies can follow up, place a soldier behind Corki, cross over with Azir E Shifting Sands, and use Azir R Emperor's Divide toward your allies.
Corki.escape: Engage just after Corki uses W Valkyrie, when his mobility is unavailable. Close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands and push Corki away with Azir R Emperor's Divide. If Corki W Valkyrie is still available, do not force your way in.
Corki.phase: Corki's base stats are low during the first five levels, creating chances to pressure him, but Azir is also weakest early, so prioritize safe farming. In mid game, Azir Q Conquering Sands has a shorter cooldown and soldiers are easier to manage. Azir's sustained damage grows strong late, but Corki also gets stronger as he gains items, so pressure him to keep him from scaling freely from the start.
Corki.teamfight: Keep Azir himself back and send only soldiers forward to keep attacking the enemy frontline. Corki R Missile Barrage also hits nearby targets, so reposition to avoid successive missiles. If an enemy enters your team's backline, push them away with Azir R Emperor's Divide; even if Corki W Valkyrie is down, move forward only in a fight you are sure to win.

Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike travels in a curve and applies a mark, so dodge sideways rather than retreating in a straight line. If it marks you, Diana E Lunar Rush may have its cooldown reset, so create distance immediately. Do not fight up close while the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade remain.
Diana.build: Diana deals mainly magic damage, and Azir has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Diana.fight: Start trading after the orbs from Diana W Pale Cascade disappear and her shield is gone. Place a soldier from Azir W Arise! between Diana and the minions, and poke with soldier attacks. Use Azir Q Conquering Sands when you have a position to move the soldier to. If Diana engages first with E Lunar Rush without a mark, respond by slowing her with Azir Q Conquering Sands or pushing her away with Azir R Emperor's Divide.
Diana.laning: Place a soldier when you need a last hit or Diana enters range, and save one Azir W Arise! charge to escape.
Diana.combo: To poke, place a soldier in front of Diana with Azir W Arise! and attack with it, then send it toward her with Azir Q Conquering Sands. Keep the attack command active during Q so the soldier can hit once more as soon as it arrives. When Diana engages, push her away with Azir R Emperor's Divide and attack the frontline with soldiers.
Diana.escape: The moment after Diana engages first with E Lunar Rush without a mark and uses her mobility is a chance to engage. If the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade are gone, close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands and push her away with Azir R Emperor's Divide to catch her. If Diana Q Crescent Strike marks you, do not engage; create distance.
Diana.phase: Azir gains strength from mid game, when Q Conquering Sands has a shorter cooldown and soldiers cycle faster, and becomes strong late as he builds attack speed and ability power.
Diana.teamfight: Stay back and attack the frontline with soldiers. If Diana enters your team's backline, push her away with Azir R Emperor's Divide. Diana R Moonfall deals more damage for each champion pulled, so keep some distance from your allies. Use vision to watch for Diana's flank as you fight.

Ekko.watch: When you see the warning for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, stay out of the marked area to avoid the stun and shield. The returning hit of Ekko Q Timewinder hurts more, so step out of its return path. If you can see Ekko's afterimage, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready; do not chase too far even if he is low on health.
Ekko.build: Ekko deals mainly magic damage, and Azir has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Ekko.fight: Place a soldier in front of Ekko with Azir W Arise! and attack through it first, then move the soldier with Azir Q Conquering Sands to poke. If Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, do not chase too far even if he looks low on health. While Ekko R Chronobreak is down, close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands and push him away with Azir R Emperor's Divide.
Ekko.laning: Place a soldier between the minions and Ekko to secure last hits while pressuring his approach. Use Azir W Arise! when you need a last hit or Ekko enters range, and save one soldier charge to escape. When you see the warning for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, move out of its area. Do not stand forward in lane when the enemy jungler's location is unknown.
Ekko.combo: To poke, place a soldier with Azir W Arise! and attack through it, then send it toward Ekko with Azir Q Conquering Sands. If Ekko closes in with E Phase Dive, push him away with Azir R Emperor's Divide to create distance. If Ekko R Chronobreak is down and your allies can follow up, place a soldier behind him, cross over with Azir E Shifting Sands, and immediately use Azir R Emperor's Divide toward your allies.
Ekko.escape: When you see the warning for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave its area to avoid the stun. Both Ekko W Parallel Convergence and R Chronobreak being down creates a good opening to start a fight. In particular, before Ekko R Chronobreak comes back, close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands and use Azir R Emperor's Divide.
Ekko.phase: Azir is weakest early, so farm safely and minimize losses. In mid game, Azir Q Conquering Sands has a shorter cooldown and soldiers are easier to manage. Late game, he grows strong as he builds attack speed and ability power, so keep Azir himself safe while attacking continuously.
Ekko.teamfight: Keep Azir himself back and send soldiers forward to keep attacking the enemy frontline. If Ekko reaches your team's backline with E Phase Dive, push him away with Azir R Emperor's Divide. When you can see Ekko's afterimage, do not chase too far because he can return with Ekko R Chronobreak.

Fizz.watch: If Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark erupts. Fizz may use Fizz Q Urchin Strike to engage as the shark knocks you up, so place a soldier in his path with Azir W Arise! to pressure him and be ready to push him away with Azir R Emperor's Divide. Do not rush to counterattack while Fizz E Playful / Trickster is available.
Fizz.build: Fizz deals primarily magic damage, and Azir has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Start with Null-Magic Mantle to survive the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Fizz.fight: Look for a counterattack immediately after Fizz E Playful / Trickster is used, and keep Azir R Emperor's Divide available. If Fizz Q Urchin Strike is still available, account for it before engaging. Also look for a trade when Fizz misses a last hit with the empowered basic attack from Fizz W Seastone Trident.
Fizz.laning: Place a soldier between the enemy minions and Fizz with Azir W Arise! to secure last hits while discouraging him from approaching. Do not waste mana constantly refreshing soldiers; focus on safe farming early. Do not stand far forward in lane if you do not know where the enemy jungler is.
Fizz.combo: To harass, place a soldier with Azir W Arise!, attack through it, then send it toward Fizz with Azir Q Conquering Sands while maintaining the attack command. If Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down and an opening to engage appears, place a soldier at your destination, move to it with Azir E Shifting Sands, and push Fizz away with Azir R Emperor's Divide.
Fizz.escape: After Fizz E Playful / Trickster is used and before it is available again, you have a chance to close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands. If Fizz Q Urchin Strike is still available, he can escape, so check his remaining mobility before going in. When being chased, place a reserved soldier in your escape direction and move to it with Azir E Shifting Sands.
Fizz.phase: Azir is weak early, so farm and limit your losses instead of forcing a kill on Fizz. In the mid game, Azir Q Conquering Sands becomes available more often and soldier use improves; look for openings when Fizz's mobility is down. Late, Azir grows strong with attack speed and ability power, but avoid facing Fizz alone.
Fizz.teamfight: Stay close to your allies and attack the frontline with soldiers placed by Azir W Arise!. When Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down, focus him together. Push Fizz away with Azir R Emperor's Divide as he enters your backline. If Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark erupts.

Galio.watch: When Galio channels Galio W Shield of Durand, he takes less damage, so stop attacking and walk out of taunt range. If Galio steps back to use Galio E Justice Punch, dodge the charge. Move out of the area where the two gusts from Galio Q Winds of War meet. Leave the area immediately when you see the landing marker for Galio R Hero's Entrance.
Galio.build: Galio deals primarily magic damage, and Azir has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Buy Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Galio.fight: Use Galio's melee range against him: keep your distance and harass with soldiers from Azir W Arise!.
Galio.laning: Place a soldier between the minions and Galio with Azir W Arise! to secure last hits while pressuring his approach. Make Galio spend abilities on the wave; when his mana is low, push the lane to give him less room to use his ultimate to influence other lanes. Place soldiers only when needed, and do not stand far forward in lane if you do not know where the enemy jungler is.
Galio.combo: To harass, place a soldier in front of Galio with Azir W Arise!, attack through it, then send it toward him with Azir Q Conquering Sands. Maintain the attack command during Q so the soldier attacks once more as soon as it arrives. If Galio is channeling Galio W Shield of Durand, stop the combo and leave taunt range.
Galio.escape: Do not go in just because Galio E Justice Punch is down; look for a window before Galio R Hero's Entrance comes back. If the taunt from Galio W Shield of Durand is also down, close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands and push him away with Azir R Emperor's Divide. Before using E to engage, make sure your allies are close enough to follow.
Galio.phase: Azir is weak early, so farm safely and limit your losses instead of forcing a kill on Galio. In the mid game, Azir Q Conquering Sands becomes available more often and soldier rotation speeds up, giving you a way to fight. Late, Azir grows strong with attack speed and ability power; stay back and keep attacking with soldiers.
Galio.teamfight: Stay back and attack the frontline with soldiers from Azir W Arise!. Leave the area when you see the landing marker for Galio R Hero's Entrance, and push Galio away with Azir R Emperor's Divide if he enters your backline. While Galio R Hero's Entrance is available, do not start small fights against his team in other lanes.

Irelia.watch: Irelia can use Irelia Q Bladesurge on low-health minions to reach you in quick succession, so step back when minions are about to die. Watch for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet. If you are trapped inside the barrier from Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait for the blades to disappear. Crossing the barrier deals additional damage and applies a strong slow.
Irelia.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Irelia deals mostly physical damage, and Azir has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Irelia.fight: Place a soldier between Irelia and the minions with Azir W Arise! and harass through it with basic attacks. Immediately after Irelia Q Bladesurge is used, you may have a chance to close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands, but prioritize safe farming early.
Irelia.laning: Do not leave low-health minions between you and Irelia; create distance when minions are about to die. Place soldiers with Azir W Arise! when you need to last hit or harass, and save one for escape. Do not stand far forward in lane if you do not know where the enemy jungler is.
Irelia.combo: To harass, place a soldier with Azir W Arise!, attack through it, then send it toward Irelia with Azir Q Conquering Sands to slow her. When engaging after Irelia Q Bladesurge is used, place a soldier, approach with Azir E Shifting Sands, and push her away with Azir R Emperor's Divide. If you place the soldier behind Irelia to dash past her, choose an angle where E will not collide with her, and try it only when your allies are close enough to follow.
Irelia.escape: Immediately after Irelia Q Bladesurge is used is your window to engage with Azir E Shifting Sands. Decide where to place the soldier from Azir W Arise! for the engage first, then follow with Azir R Emperor's Divide when your allies can follow up.
Irelia.phase: In the mid game, the cooldown of Azir Q Conquering Sands decreases and soldier rotation speeds up. Late, Azir grows strong as he gains attack speed and ability power.
Irelia.teamfight: Stay back and keep attacking the frontline with soldiers. If Irelia enters your backline, push her away with Azir R Emperor's Divide and prioritize her. Do not let her control the teamfight with Irelia R Vanguard's Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet.

Hwei.watch: If a root or pull from Hwei E Subject: Torment hits you, follow-up abilities can hit in quick succession. If the first ability hits, move immediately to dodge the second ability and the explosion from Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster can also deal damage based on maximum or missing health, so leave its marked area.
Hwei.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Hwei deals primarily magic damage, and Azir has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Hwei.fight: Position around the soldier placed with Azir W Arise! and harass with its attacks. Immediately after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used to harass or clear the wave, you can close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands. If that ability is still available, watch for a root or forced movement and do not engage first.
Hwei.laning: Place a soldier between the enemy minions and Hwei to last hit and harass. Use Azir W Arise! when he comes into range or you need a last hit, and save one charge for escape. Prioritize safe farming early, and do not stand far forward in lane if you do not know where the enemy jungler is.
Hwei.combo: To harass, place a soldier with Azir W Arise!, attack with it, then send it toward Hwei with Azir Q Conquering Sands. If Hwei E Subject: Torment is down and your allies can follow, place a soldier behind Hwei, dash past him with Azir E Shifting Sands, and push him toward your allies with Azir R Emperor's Divide. Azir E Shifting Sands stops if you collide with Hwei while dashing past, so check the angle before placing the soldier.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility ability, so immediately after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used is your chance to engage with Azir E Shifting Sands. If that ability is still available, your engage can be pushed back or rooted. If you are being chased, use Azir E Shifting Sands toward a reserved soldier to create distance.
Hwei.phase: Azir is weak early, so limit your losses and farm instead of forcing trades against Hwei. In the mid game, you can use Azir Q Conquering Sands more often and manage soldiers more smoothly. Late, Azir grows strong with attack speed and ability power, so make use of sustained damage through soldiers.
Hwei.teamfight: Stay back and keep attacking the frontline with soldiers. Take a wide path around areas Hwei has set up and passages where the enemy has vision. If the first ability hits you, reposition to avoid the follow-up. If an enemy enters your backline, push them away with Azir R Emperor's Divide. Look to engage only when Hwei E Subject: Torment is down and your allies are certain to win the fight.

Karma.watch: If Karma Q Inner Flame hits you, Karma P Gathering Fire reduces the cooldown of Karma R Mantra, so dodge from behind minions or outside its range. If the circle left by a Karma R Mantra empowered Karma Q Inner Flame hits you, walk out before it explodes shortly afterward. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, move away and break the tether before it roots you.
Karma.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first to survive and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Karma's main damage is magic, and Azir has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Karma.fight: For trades, place a soldier in front of Karma with Azir W Arise! and attack, then move the soldier with Azir Q Conquering Sands to slow her. Delay engaging while Karma W Focused Resolve is available or immediately after Karma gains the shield from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra.
Karma.laning: Focus on farming safely early. If you do not know where the enemy jungler is, do not stand forward in lane. Place a soldier between the enemy minions and Karma with Azir W Arise! to last-hit and harass at the same time. Save mana by placing soldiers when Karma enters their range or you need a last-hit.
Karma.combo: To harass, place a soldier with Azir W Arise!, attack through it, then send it toward Karma with Azir Q Conquering Sands. If Karma W Focused Resolve is down and an ally can follow up, place a soldier behind Karma with Azir W Arise!, use Azir E Shifting Sands to dash past her at an angle that avoids colliding with her, then cast Azir R Emperor's Divide toward your ally.
Karma.escape: After Karma W Focused Resolve is down, you have an opportunity to close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands. Wait until the shield from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra has also expired before going in.
Karma.phase: Azir is weakest early, so avoid Karma's harass, minimize losses, and farm safely. In mid game, the cooldown of Azir Q Conquering Sands drops and soldiers cycle faster, giving you a way to fight. Late game, Azir's accumulated attack speed and ability power give him strong sustained damage.
Karma.teamfight: Stay back and keep attacking the frontline with soldiers placed by Azir W Arise!. Wait before engaging immediately after Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra shields nearby allies. If an enemy reaches your backline, push them away with Azir R Emperor's Divide. Do not go in first while Karma W Focused Resolve is available.

Kassadin.watch: The shield from Kassadin Q Null Sphere absorbs Azir's magic poke, so deal damage after Kassadin Q Null Sphere is down.
Kassadin.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Kassadin's main damage is magic, and Azir has low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance.
Kassadin.laning: Place a soldier between the minions and Kassadin with Azir W Arise! to last-hit and harass at the same time. Using abilities unnecessarily near Kassadin reduces the cooldown of Kassadin E Force Pulse, so conserve your soldiers and mana.
Kassadin.combo: Place a soldier in front of Kassadin with Azir W Arise!, attack through it, then send it forward with Azir Q Conquering Sands while maintaining the attack command. When Kassadin R Riftwalk is down, close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands and push him away with Azir R Emperor's Divide.
Kassadin.escape: The window while Kassadin R Riftwalk is down is your chance to engage. If the slow from Kassadin E Force Pulse is also down, closing the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands is easier. Keep one soldier for escape even when you engage.
Kassadin.phase: In mid game, the cooldown of Azir Q Conquering Sands drops and managing soldiers becomes easier. Azir's sustained damage grows stronger late game, but Kassadin can also dive into Azir's backline, so do not face him alone.
Kassadin.teamfight: Keep Azir back and use soldiers to attack the enemy frontline. If Kassadin enters your backline, push him away with Azir R Emperor's Divide, and keep a soldier so you can retreat with Azir E Shifting Sands. Do not stand alone within range of Kassadin R Riftwalk.

Katarina.watch: When Katarina Q Bouncing Blade hits you, its dagger lands behind you. Back away without standing on the dagger. When Katarina R Death Lotus begins, it deals heavy damage and applies healing reduction, so push her away with Azir R Emperor's Divide to interrupt it.
Katarina.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Katarina's main damage is magic, and Azir has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Katarina.fight: Normally, keep your distance and harass based on the position of the soldier placed by Azir W Arise!. Immediately after Katarina E Shunpo is used on a target other than a dagger, you have a chance to pressure her before the mobility ability comes back, but also watch where any daggers remain on the ground.
Katarina.laning: Place a soldier between the minions and Katarina with Azir W Arise! to secure last-hits while discouraging her approach. Prioritize safe farming early, and do not stand forward in lane if you do not know where the enemy jungler is. Keep one soldier for escape.
Katarina.combo: To harass, place a soldier with Azir W Arise! and attack through it, then send it toward Katarina with Azir Q Conquering Sands to slow her. If you can engage after Katarina E Shunpo is used on a target other than a dagger, close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands and push her away with Azir R Emperor's Divide.
Katarina.escape: Immediately after Katarina E Shunpo is used on a target other than a dagger is your window to go in. Picking up a remaining dagger reduces the cooldown of Katarina E Shunpo, so check the dagger's position before engaging with Azir E Shifting Sands.
Katarina.phase: Azir is weakest early, so farm against Katarina while minimizing losses. In mid game, the cooldown of Azir Q Conquering Sands drops and you can use soldiers more often. Late game, Azir grows stronger as he gains attack speed and ability power, so deal sustained damage with soldiers.
Katarina.teamfight: Keep Azir back and attack the frontline with soldiers. Prioritize using Azir R Emperor's Divide to push Katarina away when she enters your backline. If Katarina R Death Lotus begins, interrupt it with Azir R Emperor's Divide, and protect low-health allies to deny Katarina her first kill. Position yourself so allies can also avoid daggers on the ground.

Leblanc.watch: While the mark from LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice remains, her next ability deals more damage, so stay back until the mark disappears. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits you, use Azir E Shifting Sands to get out of tether range before it roots you. Do not waste abilities on the clone from LeBlanc P Mirror Image; watch which one is actually attacking.
Leblanc.build: Early on, survive with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. LeBlanc's main damage is magic, and Azir has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Build Banshee's Veil to block her opening ability and buy time to place soldiers.
Leblanc.fight: Place a soldier between LeBlanc and the minions with Azir W Arise!, attack with it, then move it with Azir Q Conquering Sands to harass. If LeBlanc comes in with LeBlanc W Distortion, counterattack after her chance to return expires or after she returns, instead of immediately chasing deep. Right after LeBlanc W Distortion is down, you have a chance to close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands.
Leblanc.laning: Early on, focus on safe farming over kills, and do not stand forward in lane if you do not know where the enemy jungler is. Use Azir W Arise! when you need a last-hit or LeBlanc enters soldier range, and keep one soldier charge for escape. If LeBlanc pushes the lane and disappears from vision, alert your team immediately.
Leblanc.combo: To harass, place a soldier with Azir W Arise! and attack with it, then send it toward LeBlanc with Azir Q Conquering Sands while maintaining the attack command. If LeBlanc W Distortion is down and an ally can follow up, place a soldier behind LeBlanc with Azir W Arise!, dash past her with Azir E Shifting Sands, and use Azir R Emperor's Divide toward your ally. Colliding with LeBlanc during the dash stops Azir E Shifting Sands, so position the soldier carefully.
Leblanc.escape: Right after LeBlanc uses LeBlanc W Distortion is an engage window while her mobility ability is down. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains is also down, close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands and push her away with Azir R Emperor's Divide. Before using Azir E Shifting Sands to engage, check that your allies are close enough to follow up.
Leblanc.phase: Azir is weak early, so farm against LeBlanc while minimizing losses. In mid game, you can use Azir Q Conquering Sands more often and manage soldiers more frequently. Late game, fight around Azir's sustained damage from his accumulated attack speed and ability power.
Leblanc.teamfight: Keep Azir back and attack the enemy frontline with soldiers from Azir W Arise!. If LeBlanc enters your backline, push her away with Azir R Emperor's Divide, and use Azir E Shifting Sands and one soldier with an escape route in mind. Use Azir R Emperor's Divide to push an enemy toward your allies only in a fight you are certain to win.

Lux.watch: Getting hit by Lux Q Light Binding makes it easy for her follow-up abilities to hit, so bait out her Q and move after it misses. Stand apart from allies so you cannot be bound together in a line. When Lux R Final Spark's red targeting line appears, dodge to the side. If one of Lux's abilities hits you, move out of her basic attack range so she cannot trigger the Lux P Illumination mark.
Lux.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Lux deals mainly magic damage, and Azir has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Lux.fight: Poke Lux based on the position of soldiers placed with Azir W Arise!. If Lux Q Light Binding misses, you have a chance to close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands. Lux has low health and defenses, but getting into range is difficult, so do not force an engage.
Lux.laning: Place a soldier between Lux and the minions to secure last hits while pressuring her approach. Keep Lux Q Light Binding in mind and avoid lining up with an ally. Early on, focus on safe farming without wasting soldiers or mana.
Lux.combo: To poke, place a soldier with Azir W Arise!, attack through it, then send it toward Lux with Azir Q Conquering Sands. Keep your attack command active while the soldier moves so you can land another hit as soon as it arrives. If Lux Q Light Binding misses and your allies can follow up, place a soldier behind Lux with W, cross over with Azir E Shifting Sands, then use Azir R Emperor's Divide toward your allies.
Lux.escape: The moment Lux Q Light Binding is used is your chance to engage with Azir E Shifting Sands. Lux has no ability to create distance herself, so once you close the gap, you can push her back and pin her down with Azir R Emperor's Divide.
Lux.phase: Azir is weak early, so minimize losses and farm safely. In the mid game, Azir Q Conquering Sands becomes available more often and soldier rotation speeds up, giving him a way to fight. Late game, Azir deals strong sustained damage once he has built attack speed and ability power.
Lux.teamfight: Stay back and keep attacking the enemy frontline with soldiers. Do not approach grouped with allies where Lux E Lucent Singularity can block you all in one area. If an enemy reaches your backline, push them away with Azir R Emperor's Divide. Only try to bring Lux toward your allies when you are certain to win the fight.

Lissandra.watch: Lissandra Q Ice Shard passes through its first target, so do not line up with allied minions. If Lissandra W Ring of Frost roots you or Lissandra R Frozen Tomb stuns you, follow-up damage can land easily, so do not get close while either ability is available. When Lissandra throws Lissandra E Glacial Path, watch where its claw ends up because she can reactivate it to move there.
Lissandra.build: Start by surviving with Null-Magic Mantle. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots and build magic resistance against Lissandra's magic damage.
Lissandra.fight: Right after Lissandra uses Lissandra W Ring of Frost on the wave or misses it, place a soldier with Azir W Arise! and trade damage. If Lissandra E Glacial Path is also down, close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands and push her back with Azir R Emperor's Divide. If Lissandra R Frozen Tomb is still available, she can use it on herself to avoid damage, so do not commit all your finishing damage at once.
Lissandra.laning: Early on, aim for safe farming over kills, and do not stand forward if you do not know where the jungler is. Place a soldier with Azir W Arise! between the enemy minions and Lissandra to last-hit and poke at the same time. Place soldiers only when needed, and stand at an angle to allied minions to avoid the path of Lissandra Q Ice Shard as it passes through them.
Lissandra.combo: To poke, place a soldier with Azir W Arise!, attack through it, then send it toward Lissandra with Azir Q Conquering Sands. Keep your attack command active during Q so the soldier attacks again as soon as it arrives. If Lissandra E Glacial Path is down and your allies can follow up, place a soldier behind Lissandra, cross over with Azir E Shifting Sands, and use Azir R Emperor's Divide toward your allies.
Lissandra.escape: Lissandra E Glacial Path is her only movement ability, so right after she uses it is your chance to engage with Azir E Shifting Sands. Confirming that Lissandra W Ring of Frost is also down reduces the risk of being rooted. When engaging with Azir E Shifting Sands, place a soldier at your destination and choose an angle that keeps the dash from stopping when you collide with Lissandra.
Lissandra.phase: Azir is weakest early, so farm while minimizing losses. In the mid game, Azir Q Conquering Sands has a shorter cooldown and you can use soldiers more often, giving you a way to fight. Late game, built-up attack speed and ability power make Azir a key source of sustained damage.
Lissandra.teamfight: Keep Azir himself back and continuously attack the frontline with soldiers placed by Azir W Arise!. If Lissandra enters your backline, consider pushing her away with Azir R Emperor's Divide first. Check whether she has already used Lissandra E Glacial Path. If she uses Lissandra R Frozen Tomb on herself, keep attacking after her stasis ends.

Malzahar.watch: When a minion affected by Malzahar E Malefic Visions dies, the effect moves to the nearest enemy, so step away from that minion. When you see Malzahar Q Call of the Void, move outside its two portals and delay your engage until the silence ends. The suppression from Malzahar R Nether Grasp cannot be broken by the shield or movement from Azir E Shifting Sands, so do not cross an area without vision alone while Malzahar can use R.
Malzahar.build: Malzahar deals mainly magic damage and Azir has low magic resistance, so start by surviving with Null-Magic Mantle. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots and build Banshee's Veil to block a targeted opening ability and buy time to place soldiers. If you need a way to remove Malzahar R Nether Grasp, use Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar.
Malzahar.fight: When Malzahar P Void Shift is active, remove it first with poke such as Azir Q Conquering Sands before fighting. Your opportunity comes after you dodge the silence from Malzahar Q Call of the Void and the summons from Malzahar W Void Swarm disappear. Deal damage based on the position of soldiers placed with Azir W Arise!, and do not get close alone if Malzahar can use Malzahar R Nether Grasp.
Malzahar.laning: Place a soldier with Azir W Arise! between the enemy minions and Malzahar to last-hit and poke at the same time. Step away from minions affected by Malzahar E Malefic Visions, and conserve mana by placing soldiers when you need last hits or Malzahar enters their range. If Malzahar pushes the wave, remove his passive first and pressure him with your jungler.
Malzahar.combo: To poke, place a soldier in front of Malzahar with Azir W Arise!, attack through it, then send it toward him with Azir Q Conquering Sands to slow him. To engage, remove Malzahar P Void Shift first, dodge Malzahar Q Call of the Void, then place a soldier behind him with Azir W Arise!. If your allies can follow up, use Azir E Shifting Sands at an angle that will not stop against Malzahar's body, then immediately cast Azir R Emperor's Divide toward your allies.
Malzahar.escape: Malzahar has no movement ability, so close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands during the opening after Malzahar P Void Shift is removed and you dodge the silence from Malzahar Q Call of the Void. While Malzahar can use Malzahar R Nether Grasp, do not engage without an ally who can interrupt the suppression. When chased, place a saved soldier with Azir W Arise! beyond a wall and cross it with Azir E Shifting Sands.
Malzahar.phase: Azir is weak early, so prioritize safe farming, but push the wave or pressure Malzahar with your jungler when possible to give him less time to build up Malzahar W Void Swarm. In the mid game, Azir Q Conquering Sands becomes available more often and soldier control improves. Azir's sustained damage grows strong late, but Malzahar also gets stronger as he builds up, so fight with allies instead of facing him alone.
Malzahar.teamfight: Stay back and continuously attack the frontline with soldiers from Azir W Arise!. If summons from Malzahar W Void Swarm are already present, clear them first with the area attacks from Azir W Arise!. If Malzahar P Void Shift is active, remove it first with poke such as Azir Q Conquering Sands. Push enemies away with Azir R Emperor's Divide when they reach your backline. If an ally is caught by Malzahar R Nether Grasp, another ally must interrupt its cast by applying movement-impairing crowd control to Malzahar.

Mel.watch: The center of Mel E Solar Snare roots you and can be followed by overlapping Mel Q Radiant Volley, so dodge to the side. When Mel W Rebuttal is active, do not throw projectiles; pressure her with soldiers already placed by Azir W Arise!. If Mel has hit you several times, back off rather than relying on your health, and watch for Mel R Golden Eclipse while the stacks remain.
Mel.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Mel deals mainly magic damage, and Azir has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Mel.fight: Avoid the center of Mel E Solar Snare and trade after she uses Mel W Rebuttal. Attack based on the position of soldiers placed with Azir W Arise!, and use Azir Q Conquering Sands to move them where they can keep attacking. Mel has no movement ability, so you can close the gap then, but check your soldiers' positions and whether your allies are close enough to follow before engaging with Azir E Shifting Sands.
Mel.laning: Place a soldier from Azir W Arise! between the enemy minions and Mel to last-hit and poke at the same time. Pressure the wave early to slow Mel's growth, but Azir is also weak early, so do not step forward if you do not know where the enemy jungler is. Save one soldier for escape, and do not keep placing new soldiers and spending mana when you do not need to.
Mel.combo: To poke, place a soldier in front of Mel with Azir W Arise!, attack through it, then move it toward her with Azir Q Conquering Sands. If Mel has used Mel E Solar Snare and Mel W Rebuttal, you can secure the kill, and your allies can follow up, place a soldier behind Mel with Azir W Arise!, cross over with Azir E Shifting Sands, then push her toward your allies with Azir R Emperor's Divide. Position the soldier so Azir E Shifting Sands does not stop on collision with Mel.
Mel.escape: Your chance to engage comes after you dodge the root from Mel E Solar Snare and she uses Mel W Rebuttal. Mel has no movement ability, so you can close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands and push her back with Azir R Emperor's Divide. When you do not engage, save one soldier from Azir W Arise! to keep an escape route open with Azir E Shifting Sands.
Mel.phase: Azir is also weak early, but this is a chance to slow Mel's growth, so pressure the wave while farming safely. In the mid game, you can use Azir Q Conquering Sands more often and rotate soldiers faster, giving you a way to fight. Late game, Azir deals strong sustained damage, but Mel also grows stronger through a permanently stacking effect, so limit her chances to build stacks from early on rather than letting the game drag on.
Mel.teamfight: Stay back and keep attacking the frontline with soldiers from Azir W Arise!. Avoid the center of Mel E Solar Snare and the area covered by Mel Q Radiant Volley. If Mel has hit you several times, back off to avoid the execute from Mel P Searing Brilliance. Push enemies away with Azir R Emperor's Divide when they reach your backline. Even after leaving a fight, stay somewhere safe until the stacks disappear because Mel R Golden Eclipse remains a threat.

Naafiri.watch: If one Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers hits and applies bleed, back away until the bleed ends to avoid the second Q. Naafiri’s packmates reappear after Naafiri E Eviscerate, so look for a chance to clear them with the area attack from Azir W Arise!. Do not travel alone while Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit is ready.
Naafiri.build: Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Naafiri deals mostly physical damage and Azir has low armor, so build armor first. If a prolonged fight makes Naafiri’s healing a problem, consider healing reduction after building resistances.
Naafiri.fight: Keep your distance based on where you place soldiers with Azir W Arise!, and attack with them when Naafiri approaches. The moment after you clear the packmates revived by Naafiri E Eviscerate is a chance to counterattack. Do not go too deep just because one of Naafiri’s mobility abilities is down; look especially for a window before Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit comes back.
Naafiri.laning: Focus on farming safely early. Stay behind your minion wave to avoid giving Naafiri an angle to close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate. Place soldiers from Azir W Arise! between the minions and Naafiri to last-hit and poke. Keep one soldier for an escape, and do not stand ahead of the wave when you do not know where the enemy jungler is.
Naafiri.combo: To poke, place a soldier in front of Naafiri with Azir W Arise!, attack through it, then move it with Azir Q Conquering Sands. Keep the attack command active during Q so the soldier attacks again as soon as it arrives. If Naafiri jumps in, push her away with Azir R Emperor's Divide and, if needed, use Azir E Shifting Sands toward your reserved soldier to make space.
Naafiri.escape: Do not engage just because one of Naafiri’s mobility abilities is down. If Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit has not come back and her other ways to move are also down, position a soldier, close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands, and push her away with Azir R Emperor's Divide. Try this only when allies are close enough to follow up.
Naafiri.phase: Azir is weak early, so farm while minimizing losses instead of forcing kills. His soldier control improves in mid game, but Naafiri’s roams are most dangerous then, so maintain broad vision. Late game, Azir’s sustained damage is strong and Naafiri’s packmates are easily cleared by area damage, so fight with your team.
Naafiri.teamfight: Keep Azir himself in the back and continuously attack the frontline with soldiers from Azir W Arise!. When Naafiri enters your backline, push her away with Azir R Emperor's Divide, and save one soldier for an escape with Azir E Shifting Sands. Immediately after an ally dies, Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit may be usable again, so retreat at once to avoid losing more teammates in succession.

Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows larger and faster after hitting a target, so do not stand on top of an ally. If a Neeko transformed with Neeko P Inherent Glamour comes close, the windup for Neeko R Pop Blossom may be hidden; make space in advance. Do not chase the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter; watch where the real Neeko is.
Neeko.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle to survive early. Neeko deals mostly magic damage and Azir has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Neeko.fight: Poke Neeko based on where you place soldiers with Azir W Arise!. While Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down or Neeko R Pop Blossom is unavailable, you can close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands and fight. Check your soldier’s position and your route back before using Azir E Shifting Sands.
Neeko.laning: Place soldiers from Azir W Arise! between the minions and Neeko to last-hit and poke. Prioritize safe farming early, and save mana by placing a soldier only when Neeko enters range or you need a last hit. Do not stand ahead of the wave when you do not know where the enemy jungler is.
Neeko.combo: To poke, place a soldier in front of Neeko with Azir W Arise!, attack through it, then send it toward her with Azir Q Conquering Sands. Keep the attack command active so it can hit once more as soon as it arrives. If Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and Neeko R Pop Blossom are down and allies can follow up, place a soldier behind Neeko, cross over with Azir E Shifting Sands, then use Azir R Emperor's Divide toward your allies.
Neeko.escape: The moment after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is used, or while Neeko R Pop Blossom is down, is a chance to engage. Close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands, but save one soldier for an escape. If Neeko engages first, push her away with Azir R Emperor's Divide.
Neeko.phase: Azir is weak early, so farm while minimizing losses instead of forcing trades. His soldier control becomes easier in mid game, and he grows strong late game as he builds attack speed and ability power.
Neeko.teamfight: Stay in the back and continuously attack the frontline with soldiers from Azir W Arise!. If a Neeko transformed with Neeko P Inherent Glamour gets close, spread out from your allies in anticipation of Neeko R Pop Blossom. Push away Neeko when she engages with Azir R Emperor's Divide. Do not chase the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter.

Qiyana.watch: Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal can root when empowered by the river element, so back out of range first. Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent explodes when its shockwave hits terrain, so do not stand with your back to a wall, and avoid the river and narrow passages. If Qiyana disappears while holding the brush element, move into your team’s vision.
Qiyana.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Qiyana's main damage is physical, and Azir has relatively low armor, so prioritize armor.
Qiyana.fight: Trade when Qiyana has used both Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity and remains forward. In particular, before Qiyana E Audacity comes back, close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands and push her away with Azir R Emperor's Divide.
Qiyana.laning: Focus on farming safely early, and do not stand ahead of the wave when you do not know where the enemy jungler is. Place a soldier with Azir W Arise! between the enemy minions and Qiyana to secure last hits while punishing her approach. Save one soldier for an escape, and do not keep spending mana to refresh soldiers when you do not need to.
Qiyana.combo: To poke, place a soldier with Azir W Arise!, attack through it, then reposition it toward Qiyana with Azir Q Conquering Sands. Keep the attack command active while the soldier moves so it attacks again as soon as it arrives. After Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity are down, approach with Azir E Shifting Sands and use Azir R Emperor's Divide.
Qiyana.escape: Do not engage when only Qiyana W Terrashape is down; she can escape with Qiyana E Audacity. The window to engage with Azir E Shifting Sands is after both mobility abilities are down and before Qiyana E Audacity comes back. When chased, place your reserved soldier across a wall and escape with Azir E Shifting Sands.
Qiyana.phase: Azir is weak early, so farm while minimizing losses. Qiyana is strongest in mid game; avoid giving her an advantage, build armor, and move with your team. Late game, Azir’s sustained damage is strong, so fight from the back with soldiers while avoiding terrain where Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent can explode.
Qiyana.teamfight: Keep Azir in the back and continuously attack the frontline with soldiers placed by Azir W Arise!. If Qiyana enters your backline, push her away with Azir R Emperor's Divide. Move with your team, but stand away from terrain so Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent cannot hit you together.

Orianna.watch: Watch where Orianna places her ball with Orianna Q Command: Attack and move accordingly. Avoid the area around the ball, where Orianna R Command: Shockwave can pull you in. Early on, do not stay in a fight while repeatedly taking basic attacks empowered by Orianna P Clockwork Windup.
Orianna.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle to survive early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Orianna deals mostly magic damage and Azir has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Orianna.fight: The moment after Orianna moves her ball away from herself with Orianna Q Command: Attack is a chance to trade. Attack based on where you place soldiers with Azir W Arise!, but do not prolong a basic attack trade against Orianna P Clockwork Windup. Close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands when Orianna’s defensive tools are down and the ball’s position is safe.
Orianna.laning: Place a soldier with Azir W Arise! between the enemy minions and Orianna to last-hit and poke. Place soldiers when you need a last hit or Orianna enters range; otherwise, conserve mana and soldier charges. Focus on farming safely early, and do not stand ahead of the wave when you do not know where the enemy jungler is.
Orianna.combo: To poke, place a soldier with Azir W Arise!, attack through it, then send it toward Orianna with Azir Q Conquering Sands. When Orianna’s defensive tools are down and you engage, place a soldier behind her with Azir W Arise!, use Azir E Shifting Sands at an angle that avoids colliding with her, then use Azir R Emperor's Divide toward your allies. Try this engage only when allies are close enough to follow up.
Orianna.escape: Orianna has no ability to create distance on her own, so look to engage when Orianna R Command: Shockwave is down and the ball’s position is safe. You can close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands and push her away with Azir R Emperor's Divide. When you are not engaging, save one charge of Azir W Arise! to keep an escape route with Azir E Shifting Sands.
Orianna.phase: Early on, Azir’s defenses are weak and he cannot use Azir Q Conquering Sands often, so farm while minimizing losses. Orianna also has low health and defensive stats early, but do not overextend because of that. Azir’s soldier control becomes easier in mid game, and his sustained damage grows strong late game as he builds attack speed and ability power.
Orianna.teamfight: Keep Azir himself in the back and continuously attack the frontline with soldiers placed by Azir W Arise!. Watch the ball’s position more than Orianna herself, and avoid places where Orianna R Command: Shockwave can pull you in. If an enemy enters your backline, push them away with Azir R Emperor's Divide. Engage to pull an enemy toward your team only in a fight your team is sure to win.

Ryze.watch: If Ryze E Spell Flux marks you, stay away from allies until the mark expires. While marked, Ryze W Rune Prison roots you and Ryze Q Overload deals increased damage, so prioritize dodging Ryze E Spell Flux. When you see Ryze R Realm Warp, watch its destination. If you can reach Ryze before it activates, push him away with Azir R Emperor's Divide to interrupt the cast.
Ryze.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on, then choose Mercury's Treads. Ryze deals primarily magic damage and Azir has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Ryze.fight: Use the position of the soldier summoned by Azir W Arise! to find an angle to hit Ryze. In trades, attack with the soldier first, then use Azir Q Conquering Sands to reposition it and slow Ryze. Early on, its long cooldown means you should use Q only when you need to reposition. Look for a chance to close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands when Ryze R Realm Warp is down and you have no Ryze E Spell Flux mark.
Ryze.laning: Place a soldier between the minions and Ryze to last-hit while pressuring him when he approaches. Ryze also lacks mana and damage early, so farm safely and look for chances to poke. Avoid spending mana by summoning soldiers unnecessarily, and stay back from the front of the lane when you do not know where the enemy jungler is.
Ryze.combo: To poke, summon a soldier in front of Ryze with Azir W Arise!, attack with it, then send it toward Ryze with Azir Q Conquering Sands while keeping the attack command active. When Ryze R Realm Warp is down and allies can follow up, summon a soldier behind Ryze with Azir W Arise!, use Azir E Shifting Sands to pass him at an angle that avoids colliding with his body, then push him toward your allies with Azir R Emperor's Divide.
Ryze.escape: When you have no Ryze E Spell Flux mark and Ryze W Rune Prison is down, close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands, then push Ryze away with Azir R Emperor's Divide.
Ryze.phase: Azir is at his weakest early, while Ryze also lacks mana and damage. Focus on farming safely and slow Ryze's growth with poke when possible. In mid game, Azir Q Conquering Sands has a shorter cooldown and soldiers can be cycled faster, giving Azir a way to fight. Late game, Azir deals strong sustained damage once he has built attack speed and ability power.
Ryze.teamfight: Stay back and keep attacking the frontline with soldiers from Azir W Arise!. If Ryze moves toward your allies, push him away with Azir R Emperor's Divide. If Ryze E Spell Flux marks you, move away from your allies. Use Azir E Shifting Sands and Azir R Emperor's Divide to push Ryze toward your allies only when your team is certain to win the fight.

Sylas.watch: The first dash of Sylas E Abscond / Abduct deals no damage, but the second chain knocks you up if it hits, leaving you open to follow-up attacks. Time Azir E Shifting Sands for the chain, not the first dash, and move out of the intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash immediately.
Sylas.build: Sylas deals primarily magic damage and Azir has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Start with Null-Magic Mantle to survive the early game and choose Mercury's Treads.
Sylas.fight: Normally, keep your distance and attack from the position of the soldier summoned by Azir W Arise!. Before Sylas E Abscond / Abduct comes back up, you can close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands and fight.
Sylas.laning: Place a soldier between the minions and Sylas, and summon one when Sylas enters its range or you need to last-hit. If you do not know where the enemy jungler is, stay back from the front of the lane and keep one soldier available to escape with Azir E Shifting Sands.
Sylas.combo: To poke, summon a soldier in front of Sylas with Azir W Arise!, attack through it, then reposition it with Azir Q Conquering Sands. Keep the attack command active during Q so the soldier can attack again after arriving. Once Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is down, close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands and push him away with Azir R Emperor's Divide.
Sylas.escape: Do not go in just because Sylas E Abscond / Abduct used its first dash. Dodge the second chain and look for an opening before E comes back up. If Sylas W Kingslayer is still available, account for his ability to use it to get away. Use Azir E Shifting Sands to close the gap when entering, while watching for situations where you need it to dodge the chain or escape.
Sylas.phase: In mid game, Azir Q Conquering Sands has a shorter cooldown and soldiers can be cycled faster. Late game, Azir grows stronger as he builds attack speed and ability power, so keep dealing damage with soldiers.
Sylas.teamfight: Stay back and keep attacking the frontline with soldiers; do not move Azir himself forward. Attack right after Sylas goes in so he has no time to heal with Sylas W Kingslayer.

Syndra.watch: If a Syndra Q Dark Sphere lands between you and Syndra, move off its line: Syndra E Scatter the Weak can push it into you and stun you. Move away from areas with multiple Syndra Q Dark Spheres, where Syndra R Unleashed Power is more dangerous. When your health is low, watch for the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Syndra.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle to survive the early game and choose Mercury's Treads. Syndra deals primarily magic damage and Azir has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Resistance does not reduce the true damage from Syndra W Force of Will, so watch your total health as well.
Syndra.fight: Use the position of the soldier summoned by Azir W Arise! to find an attack angle, and do not force your way in while Syndra E Scatter the Weak is available. Once it is down, you have a chance to close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands. When entering, position your soldier with the knowledge that Azir E Shifting Sands stops if you collide with Syndra.
Syndra.laning: Summon a soldier with Azir W Arise! between the enemy minions and Syndra to last-hit and poke. Summon soldiers when you need to last-hit or Syndra enters attack range, and keep one available to escape. Syndra Q Dark Sphere, Syndra W Force of Will, and Syndra E Scatter the Weak are placed on the ground or thrown, so use the movement speed from early boots to move out of their telegraphed areas.
Syndra.combo: To poke, summon a soldier in front of Syndra with Azir W Arise!, attack through it, then send it toward her with Azir Q Conquering Sands. Keep the attack command active while the soldier moves during Q to land another hit as soon as it arrives. If Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down and allies can follow up, summon a soldier behind Syndra, pass her with Azir E Shifting Sands, then push her toward your allies with Azir R Emperor's Divide.
Syndra.escape: Syndra E Scatter the Weak is her only self-defense tool, so immediately after she uses it is your chance to enter. Close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands, placing a soldier at your destination before going in.
