Azir E Shifting Sands can stop midway if you collide with Syndra, so angle it around her body if you need to get behind her.
Syndra.phase: Azir is weak early, so focus on farming safely and stay back from the front of the lane when you do not know where the enemy jungler is. In mid game, you can use Azir Q Conquering Sands more often and manage soldiers more frequently. Late game, Azir grows stronger as he builds attack speed and ability power, so deal sustained damage with soldiers.
Syndra.teamfight: Stay back and keep attacking the frontline with soldiers. Avoid areas with multiple Syndra Q Dark Spheres, and do not stand in line with a sphere where Syndra E Scatter the Weak can stun you. If an enemy reaches your backline, push them away with Azir R Emperor's Divide. Push Syndra toward your allies only when your team is certain to win the fight.

Talon.watch: If Talon W Rake hits you on its way out, move out of its return path to prevent passive stacks and the bleed from triggering. While Talon R Shadow Assault is available, do not chase too far: he can use its stealth to escape or counterattack.
Talon.build: Start with Cloth Armor to withstand Talon's physical damage and choose Plated Steelcaps. Continue to build armor before magic resistance, but also build health to account for Talon's flat penetration. Talon has relatively high magic resistance, so include magic penetration in your offensive items.
Talon.fight: Summon a soldier with Azir W Arise! and attack from a safe distance. Use Azir Q Conquering Sands to move the soldier back into range. Right after Talon uses Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is a chance to close the gap. Look to counterattack if Talon R Shadow Assault has already been used.
Talon.laning: Farm safely from behind minions early, and do not push the wave too hard and let Talon reach the next level first. Place soldiers between the minions and Talon to last-hit and poke, but keep one charge of Azir W Arise! for an escape. If Talon leaves lane, share his location and establish vision along the jungle routes.
Talon.combo: To poke, summon a soldier with Azir W Arise!, land a basic attack through it, then reposition it with Azir Q Conquering Sands while keeping the attack command active. If Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is down and allies can follow up, summon a soldier behind Talon, pass him with Azir E Shifting Sands, then cast Azir R Emperor's Divide toward your allies. Position the soldier so E does not stop when you collide with Talon.
Talon.escape: Right after Talon uses Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is your opening to enter. Avoid the slow from Talon W Rake, make space, then dash to a soldier with Azir E Shifting Sands. If you have confirmed that Talon R Shadow Assault is also down, look to chase and counterattack.
Talon.phase: In mid game, Azir Q Conquering Sands has a shorter cooldown and soldier management improves. Late game, Azir's sustained damage grows stronger and Talon's impact falls, so fight as a group.
Talon.teamfight: Stay back and keep attacking the frontline with soldiers. If Talon dives your backline, push him away with Azir R Emperor's Divide and respond alongside your allies. Attempt to dive in and push Talon toward your allies only when you are clearly winning the fight.

Veigar.watch: If Veigar E Event Horizon traps you, crossing its edge will stun you. Move inside it and wait for it to disappear. Sidestep the ground indicator for Veigar W Dark Matter. If you are below half health, move out of range of Veigar R Primordial Burst, which grows stronger based on your missing health.
Veigar.build: Veigar deals mainly magic damage, and Azir has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Get a Null-Magic Mantle to survive early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Veigar.fight: When Veigar E Event Horizon is down, place a soldier with Azir W Arise! and attack from its position. Keep moving so you can dodge Veigar W Dark Matter. Before going in with Azir E Shifting Sands, check where you will place the soldier and whether your allies are close enough to follow.
Veigar.laning: Place a soldier between Veigar and the minions to last-hit while pressuring him when he approaches. Avoid taking needless hits from Veigar Q Baleful Strike and helping him scale. Place soldiers only when needed, preserving mana and one charge for escape.
Veigar.combo: To poke, place a soldier with Azir W Arise!, land a soldier attack, then send the soldier toward Veigar with Azir Q Conquering Sands. If Veigar E Event Horizon is down and your allies can follow, place a soldier behind Veigar, cross over with Azir E Shifting Sands, and use Azir R Emperor's Divide toward your allies.
Veigar.escape: When Veigar E Event Horizon is down, you have a chance to close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands. If you are trapped inside it, do not rush toward the edge. Move inside, then use Azir E Shifting Sands when you can get out.
Veigar.phase: Azir is also weak early, so do not step forward if you do not know where the enemy jungler is. Soldier control becomes easier in mid game, and Azir's sustained damage grows strong late. Veigar's stacks also keep growing, so check your position and whether Veigar E Event Horizon has been used before a fight.
Veigar.teamfight: Stay back and attack the frontline with soldiers; do not move Azir himself forward. If an enemy enters your backline, push them away with Azir R Emperor's Divide. Before an objective fight, check Veigar's position and whether Veigar E Event Horizon has been used.

TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate is holding a gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, stay outside his basic attack range: one attack will stun you.
TwistedFate.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first early on and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Twisted Fate deals mainly magic damage, and Azir has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
TwistedFate.fight: Look for attack angles based on the position of soldiers placed with Azir W Arise!, and keep your distance while a gold card is ready. Once Twisted Fate has used the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card or Twisted Fate R Destiny is down, you have a chance to close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands.
TwistedFate.laning: Place a soldier with Azir W Arise! between the enemy minions and Twisted Fate to last-hit and poke. Stand behind minions to reduce poke damage from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards. Farm safely early, conserve soldiers and mana, and do not stand at the front of the lane if you do not know where the enemy jungler is.
TwistedFate.combo: Place a soldier in front of Twisted Fate with Azir W Arise!, land a soldier attack, then send the soldier in with Azir Q Conquering Sands while maintaining the attack command. When Twisted Fate's gold card and Twisted Fate R Destiny are down, close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands and push him away with Azir R Emperor's Divide.
TwistedFate.escape: Go in just after Twisted Fate has used the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, or while Twisted Fate R Destiny is down. Close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands, but save one soldier for escape.
TwistedFate.phase: Azir is weak early, so reduce your losses through safe farming instead of overcommitting to kill Twisted Fate. In mid game, Azir Q Conquering Sands becomes available more often and soldier control gets faster, giving you the strength to fight. Late, Azir grows strong with attack speed and ability power, so keep soldiers in front and deal sustained damage.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Keep Azir himself back and attack the frontline with soldiers from Azir W Arise!. If Twisted Fate enters your backline, push him away with Azir R Emperor's Divide. If you see him trying to teleport with Twisted Fate R Destiny within range, interrupt it with Azir R Emperor's Divide.

Vex.watch: Do not dash with Azir E Shifting Sands while Vex P Doom 'n Gloom is ready. Vex E Looming Darkness covers a larger area at long range, so if you are already within range, dodge a short distance to the side. If Vex R Shadow Surge hits you, move toward your allies and prepare for the follow-up dash.
Vex.build: Get a Null-Magic Mantle to survive early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Vex deals mainly magic damage, and Azir has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Vex.fight: Look for a window when Vex P Doom 'n Gloom has been used on the wave or for poke and Vex W Personal Space is also down. Otherwise, keep your distance and attack with soldiers placed by Azir W Arise!. Use Azir E Shifting Sands to go in only during that window.
Vex.laning: Place a soldier with Azir W Arise! between the enemy minions and Vex to last-hit and poke. Place soldiers only when needed, and use Azir Q Conquering Sands only when you have a reason to move one. Prioritize safe farming early, and do not stand at the front of the lane if you do not know where the enemy jungler is.
Vex.combo: To poke, place a soldier with Azir W Arise!, land a soldier attack, then send the soldier toward Vex with Azir Q Conquering Sands. If Vex P Doom 'n Gloom has been used and Vex W Personal Space is down, you can place a soldier behind Vex, cross over with Azir E Shifting Sands, and use Azir R Emperor's Divide toward your allies. Attempt this only when the angle keeps Azir E Shifting Sands from hitting Vex and your allies are close enough to follow.
Vex.escape: Close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands during a window when Vex P Doom 'n Gloom has also been used. If Vex W Personal Space is down too, push her away with Azir R Emperor's Divide.
Vex.phase: Azir is weak early, so focus on reducing losses and farming safely rather than getting kills. In mid game, Azir Q Conquering Sands has a shorter cooldown and soldier rotation gets faster, giving you the strength to fight. Late, Azir grows strong with attack speed and ability power, so deal sustained damage with soldiers.
Vex.teamfight: Azir stays behind and uses Azir W Arise! soldiers to attack the enemy frontline. Have allies marked by Vex R Shadow Surge stay close to the team, and knock Vex back with Azir R Emperor's Divide if she dashes in. If Vex R Shadow Surge kills a low-health ally, it may reset, so move them out of Vex's range before the fight.

Viktor.watch: Viktor E Hextech Ray travels in a straight line, so do not stand in line with the minion wave; sidestep it. If Viktor W Gravity Field is placed, stop trading inside it and leave immediately to avoid the stun.
Viktor.build: Viktor deals mainly magic damage, so buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and build magic resistance. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Viktor.fight: Keep your distance based on your soldiers' positions. Place a soldier in front of Viktor with Azir W Arise! and attack, then move the soldier with Azir Q Conquering Sands to poke. If you get a chance to close the gap after avoiding Viktor W Gravity Field, go in with Azir E Shifting Sands and push him away with Azir R Emperor's Divide.
Viktor.laning: Place a soldier with Azir W Arise! between the minions and Viktor to last-hit and poke. Azir is weak early, so farm safely and do not stand at the front of the lane if you do not know where the enemy jungler is. Spend soldiers and mana when you need a last hit or poke, and save one soldier charge for escape.
Viktor.combo: To poke, place a soldier with Azir W Arise! and attack through it, then send it toward Viktor with Azir Q Conquering Sands and attack again. If your allies can follow and you have avoided Viktor W Gravity Field, place a soldier behind Viktor, cross over with Azir E Shifting Sands, and use Azir R Emperor's Divide toward your allies. Position the soldier so Azir E Shifting Sands does not stop on Viktor.
Viktor.escape: After leaving Viktor W Gravity Field, look for a chance to go in. Viktor has no dash, so close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands and push him away with Azir R Emperor's Divide. If Viktor W Gravity Field is active, leave its area first.
Viktor.phase: Azir is weak early, but Viktor has yet to build up his upgrade stacks, so farm safely while looking for chances to poke. In mid game, Azir's soldier control improves, but check whether Viktor has gained upgrades before reassessing trades. Azir deals strong sustained damage late, but Viktor also grows stronger over time, so do not face him alone.
Viktor.teamfight: Stay back and keep attacking the frontline with soldiers from Azir W Arise!. Do not remain inside Viktor W Gravity Field, and move out of the line of Viktor E Hextech Ray. If an enemy enters your backline, push them away with Azir R Emperor's Divide.

Xerath.watch: Xerath Q Arcanopulse passes through minions, so standing behind them alone will not protect you. When Xerath starts charging it, change direction and move far to the side. Be especially careful of Xerath E Shocking Orb: if it stuns you, follow-up attacks can hit you.
Xerath.build: Early on, start with Null-Magic Mantle to survive and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Xerath deals mainly magic damage, and Azir has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Xerath.fight: Place a soldier in front of Xerath with Azir W Arise! and attack, then move the soldier with Azir Q Conquering Sands to harass him. Right after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are used, you have an opening to close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands.
Xerath.laning: Place a soldier between the minions and Xerath to last-hit and harass at the same time. Prioritize safe farming early, and keep one charge of Azir W Arise! for an escape route. Avoid Xerath's heavy damage and hold out; when he runs low on mana, push the wave and call your jungler.
Xerath.combo: To harass, place a soldier with Azir W Arise!, attack through it, then send it toward Xerath with Azir Q Conquering Sands. If Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down and your allies can follow up, place a soldier behind Xerath, dash across with Azir E Shifting Sands, then push him toward your allies with Azir R Emperor's Divide. Position the soldier so you do not collide with Xerath and stop during the dash.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility ability, so the moment after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are used is your opening to engage. Close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands and, if you can secure the kill, push him away with Azir R Emperor's Divide.
Xerath.phase: Azir is weakest early, so minimize losses while enduring Xerath's long-range harass. In mid game, you can use Azir Q Conquering Sands more often and manage soldiers more easily, giving you room to fight. Late game, Azir deals strong sustained damage once he has built attack speed and ability power.
Xerath.teamfight: Keep Azir himself back and send soldiers placed with Azir W Arise! forward to attack continuously. If you see Xerath begin casting Xerath R Rite of the Arcane, dodge immediately; his inability to move while casting can also be an opening to engage. Use Azir R Emperor's Divide primarily to push back enemies entering your team's backline.

Vladimir.watch: When Vladimir charges Vladimir E Tides of Blood, put minions between you and him or move out of range. Save Azir R Emperor's Divide while Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is available. If Vladimir R Hemoplague hits you, retreat until its effect ends because you take increased damage.
Vladimir.build: Early on, start with Null-Magic Mantle to survive and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Vladimir deals mainly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. If fights drag on because of his healing, build Morellonomicon between your core items.
Vladimir.fight: Place a soldier with Azir W Arise! and deal damage based on its position. First, use soldier attacks to draw out Vladimir W Sanguine Pool; once the pool ends, look for Azir R Emperor's Divide. Before going in with Azir E Shifting Sands, check that your allies are close enough to follow up.
Vladimir.laning: Place a soldier between Vladimir and the minions to last-hit while pressuring his approach. Place soldiers when you need to last-hit or when Vladimir enters range, preserving mana and a means of escape.
Vladimir.combo: To harass, place a soldier with Azir W Arise!, attack with it, then move it with Azir Q Conquering Sands and attack once more. After Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is used, place a soldier behind him with Azir W Arise!, dash across with Azir E Shifting Sands, and use Azir R Emperor's Divide toward your allies. Attempt this engage only when you have an angle where Vladimir will not block Azir E Shifting Sands and your allies are close enough to follow up.
Vladimir.escape: When Vladimir W Sanguine Pool ends, you have an opening to close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands and land Azir R Emperor's Divide. Vladimir moves more slowly while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood, so use that time to adjust your spacing. If you have no angle to engage, keep one soldier for an escape route with Azir E Shifting Sands.
Vladimir.phase: Farm safely as Azir and apply pressure when you know where the enemy jungler is. In mid game, Azir Q Conquering Sands and soldier management become easier; late game, Azir grows strong as he builds attack speed and ability power. Vladimir also becomes harder to face over time, so do not let early opportunities pass.
Vladimir.teamfight: Stay back as Azir and keep attacking the frontline with soldiers. Spread out so Vladimir R Hemoplague does not hit several of you, and retreat until its effect ends if it hits you. If Vladimir enters your team's backline, push him away with Azir R Emperor's Divide, but watch for when Vladimir W Sanguine Pool has been used.

Yone.watch: When Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions to prepare his whirlwind, keep your distance until the stacks expire. Yone gains movement speed when he dives in with Yone E Soul Unbound, and its return can deal additional damage, so move out of range early if you are low on health. Yone R Fate Sealed pulls enemies along its path and moves him behind the last champion hit, so do not stand alone in the backline during teamfights.
Yone.fight: When Yone's whirlwind from Yone Q Mortal Steel is not ready, place a soldier with Azir W Arise! and trade damage while keeping your distance. Before Yone R Fate Sealed is available again is an opening to engage. Check whether he has other mobility options left, then close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands and use Azir R Emperor's Divide.
Yone.laning: Prioritize safe farming early, placing a soldier between the minions and Yone to last-hit and harass at the same time. Back off when Yone prepares his whirlwind from Yone Q Mortal Steel, and do not stand forward in lane when you do not know where the enemy jungler is. Keep one charge of Azir W Arise! for escape, and save mana by placing soldiers only when needed.
Yone.combo: To harass, place a soldier in front of Yone with Azir W Arise!, land an auto attack through it, then send it toward him with Azir Q Conquering Sands. Keep the attack command active while sending the soldier with Azir Q Conquering Sands so it can attack again as soon as it arrives. When Yone R Fate Sealed is unavailable and you have an opening to engage, position a soldier, approach with Azir E Shifting Sands, and push Yone away with Azir R Emperor's Divide.
Yone.escape: Do not engage just because Yone used one mobility ability. Look especially for a window before Yone R Fate Sealed is available again, but keep your distance first if his whirlwind from Yone Q Mortal Steel is ready or Yone E Soul Unbound is still available. When chased, place a soldier in your escape direction with the charge of Azir W Arise! you saved, then move to it with Azir E Shifting Sands.
Yone.phase: Both champions are weak early, but Azir has low early health and defensive stats, and Azir Q Conquering Sands has a long cooldown, so minimizing losses is important. Azir manages soldiers more easily in mid game and grows strong late as he builds attack speed and ability power.
Yone.teamfight: Keep Azir himself back and attack the frontline with soldiers. If Yone enters your team's backline, push him away with Azir R Emperor's Divide. Space yourself from allies so Yone W Spirit Cleave does not clip multiple champions. Check your team's formation so you are not the last champion hit by Yone R Fate Sealed in the backline.

Zed.watch: Watch the position of Zed W Living Shadow and move out of the slow area of Zed E Shadow Slash. If Zed R Death Mark is applied to you, push Zed away with Azir R Emperor's Divide to stop him from building up damage.
Zed.build: Buy Cloth Armor first early on and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Zed deals mainly physical damage, and Azir has low armor, so build armor first.
Zed.fight: Look to trade after Zed uses Zed W Living Shadow, once the shadow has disappeared or Zed has already changed position. Attack first with a soldier placed by Azir W Arise!, then use Azir Q Conquering Sands to move it where it can attack again.
Zed.laning: Farm safely early and do not give Zed an advantage. Place a soldier between the minions and Zed to last-hit and harass at the same time, and do not stand forward in lane when you do not know where the enemy jungler is. Save one charge of Azir W Arise! for escape.
Zed.combo: To harass, place a soldier in front of Zed with Azir W Arise!, land a basic attack, then send the soldier toward Zed with Azir Q Conquering Sands. Keep the attack command active while using Azir Q Conquering Sands so the soldier attacks again as soon as it arrives.
Zed.escape: You have an opening to engage after Zed uses Zed W Living Shadow if the shadow has disappeared or Zed has changed position, and Zed R Death Mark is still unavailable. Close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands and push him away with Azir R Emperor's Divide. Do not rush in after only one mobility ability is used, since Zed may still have another way to move.
Zed.phase: Azir is weakest early, so minimize losses while farming. Zed is strongest in mid game, so avoid facing him alone and group with your allies. Late game, Azir's sustained damage grows stronger and Zed weakens, so fight together.
Zed.teamfight: Stay back as Azir and attack the enemy frontline with soldiers. If Zed enters your team's backline, push him away with Azir R Emperor's Divide and use the remaining wall to block his approach.

Zoe.watch: If Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble hits you, you fall asleep shortly afterward, making you an easy target for Zoe Q Paddle Star!. Dodge the bubble when you see it. If it hits, move behind a wall or an ally before the sleep takes effect. Zoe always returns to the starting point of Zoe R Portal Jump, so remember where it is.
Zoe.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle to survive the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Zoe deals mainly magic damage, and Azir has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, so dodging the bubble takes priority.
Zoe.fight: Keep your distance based on the position of the soldier summoned by Azir W Arise!. Attack with the soldier, then use Azir Q Conquering Sands to move it and apply a slow. If Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is on cooldown, look for a chance to close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands. If Zoe uses Zoe R Portal Jump, target the moment she returns to its starting point.
Zoe.laning: Place a soldier between the enemy minions and Zoe to secure last hits while pressuring her approach. Focus on safe farming early, and do not stand forward in lane when the enemy jungler's position is unknown. Azir Q Conquering Sands has a long early cooldown, so use it when you have a reason to move a soldier.
Zoe.combo: To poke, summon a soldier with Azir W Arise!, attack through it, then send it toward Zoe with Azir Q Conquering Sands. If Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is on cooldown and your allies can follow up, place a soldier behind Zoe, cross over with Azir E Shifting Sands, and cast Azir R Emperor's Divide toward your allies. Azir E Shifting Sands stops if it collides with Zoe, so check the angle for placing the soldier first.
Zoe.escape: The moment after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble goes on cooldown is your window to engage with Azir E Shifting Sands. As you go in, use Azir R Emperor's Divide to push Zoe and block her escape route.
Zoe.phase: Azir is weakest early, so minimize losses and farm safely. In the mid game, the cooldown of Azir Q Conquering Sands decreases, letting you use soldiers more often. Late game, Azir deals strong sustained damage once he has built attack speed and ability power.
Zoe.teamfight: Stay back and keep attacking the frontline with soldiers. When Zoe fires Zoe Q Paddle Star! and redirects it, you can interrupt her with Azir R Emperor's Divide. If an enemy dives your backline, push them away with Azir R Emperor's Divide. Look to engage with Azir E Shifting Sands only after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is on cooldown.

Yasuo.watch: Yasuo E Sweeping Blade lets him use minions to close the gap, so watch your spacing where minions are plentiful. After Yasuo lands Yasuo Q Steel Tempest twice in a row, the next cast launches a tornado that knocks you up; sidestep it when the stacks are ready. When Yasuo W Wind Wall is active, save projectiles it would block until the wall disappears.
Yasuo.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Yasuo deals mainly physical damage, and Azir has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Yasuo.fight: Remove the shield from Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer with light poke before trading damage. Right after Yasuo uses the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, he briefly has no way to knock you up, so attack with a soldier summoned by Azir W Arise!. Use Azir Q Conquering Sands when you have a clear place to reposition a soldier.
Yasuo.laning: Prioritize safe farming early. Place a soldier between the enemy minions and Yasuo to look for last hits and poke at the same time. Keeping the wave thin on your side reduces the minions Yasuo can use to approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. When the enemy jungler's position is unknown, do not stand forward in lane, and keep one soldier charge for escape.
Yasuo.combo: If Yasuo has used the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath is still on cooldown, close the gap with Azir E Shifting Sands and push him away with Azir R Emperor's Divide.
Yasuo.escape: Yasuo can use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade again after a short time, so do not engage just because he used it once. Look for an opening right after he launches the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, while Yasuo R Last Breath is still on cooldown. If it becomes dangerous, escape with Azir E Shifting Sands toward the soldier you kept in reserve.
Yasuo.phase: Azir is weakest early, so against Yasuo, focus on farming while minimizing losses instead of forcing trades. In the mid game, the cooldown of Azir Q Conquering Sands decreases, letting you use soldiers more often. Late game, Azir becomes stronger as he builds attack speed and ability power, so deal sustained damage with soldiers.
Yasuo.teamfight: Stay back and attack the frontline with soldiers. If Yasuo dives your backline, push him away with Azir R Emperor's Divide and block his path with the wall. Only when your allies are certain to win the fight should you try to cross behind Yasuo with Azir E Shifting Sands and push him toward your allies.
